title: Nonprofit Security Grant Program subrecipient records, Hawaii (FY2019-FY2025)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Hawaii Uniform Information Practices Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. All records identifying the nonprofit organizations that received subawards under the Nonprofit Security Grant Program (NSGP) for federal fiscal years 2019 through 2025, including subrecipient names, addresses, award amounts, and award dates;
2. All NSGP subaward applications (including applicant organization names), award notifications, grant agreements, and denial notices for the same period.

Records between October 1, 2018 and September 30, 2025, from the office that administers U.S. Department of Homeland Security / FEMA grant programs, including the following words/phrases: "Nonprofit Security Grant Program," "NSGP," "nonprofit security," "subrecipient."

If any part of these documents are exempt from disclosure, please be sure to review and release all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions of responsive documents, as the law requires.

I request that I be properly classified as a media requester. I am an assistant editor at Reason Magazine who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. Please contact me if you have any questions about my media status.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
